brief: @buildthis.bisks.net make me a website that lets me put in two handles and shows a breakdown of who likes each others posts more than the other and shows a feed side by side of each post and reply (with thread context) that each side liked with a total count and a > or <
note: built favoritism — downloads both accounts' whole like history straight from their PDS, tallies who likes who more (with a real > or <), and lines up every liked post + its reply context side by side.
